title: Stay wet too long and things start to wrinkle 🛁
caption:
It's not water soaking in 🤯
Tag the one who stays in the bath for hours 👇
first_comment: Did you think it was water? 👇
sources: Lewis T. & Pickering G. W. (1935) 'Circulatory changes in the fingers in some diseases of the nervous system, with special reference to the digital atrophy of peripheral nerve lesions', Clinical Science 2: 149-175 (denervated fingers do not wrinkle)

Haseleu J. et al. (2014) 'Water-induced finger wrinkles do not affect touch acuity or dexterity in handling wet objects', PLOS ONE 9: e84949; Wilder-Smith E. P. (2004) 'Water immersion wrinkle test for neuropathy'
